variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body: The project {project} is badly behind schedule. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Construction timetable falls seriously short
variants.body: Construction on {project} is severely delayed. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A project waits beyond its schedule
variants.body: The project {project} has fallen badly behind its schedule. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
